{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend structured blazer in charcoal grey (#3a454f), tailored fit with a moderate shoulder line and elbow-length sleeves, color #3a454f, heavy woven wool.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in stone grey heather (#8c9299), relaxed but polished cut from mid-thigh to ankle, color #8c9299, smooth stretch cotton-blend.
White button-down blouse in crisp Oxford weave, classic collar with a slight drop shoulder and full length to hip, color #ffffff, fine poplin cotton.
Chunky leather loafers in oxidized black (#1a1a1b), square toe with a low platform for traction on salted roads, color #1a1a1b, calfskin leather with rubber soles.
A thick wool scarf in muted rust (#c27868) to add warmth against the frost without exposing skin, color #c27868, dense knit wool.

This outfit works perfectly for walking to work in snowy conditions while strictly adhering to her desire for no exposed zones, offering full coverage from head to toe with a polished yet comfortable look. The heavy wool fabrics and platform loafers provide necessary warmth and grip on salted streets without sacrificing the "neat" business aesthetic required for the morning commute. Every piece is chosen to create a cohesive, professional silhouette that feels both stylish and practical against the cold frost."}
